facts.text: Grimny's ghost believes his brother Bral, the greediest of the seven dwarf brothers, killed him. Did Bral really murder Grimny, and why?

Where is Bral now? Grimny says Bral tried to sell a treasure map in a faraway town and came back penniless, and Sir Phidipaldi and Dr. Uriah conclude Bral is the dwarf whose map they won in a gambling bet.
Dunk wears a magic ring taken from a dead dwarf's hand at the mine; it let him alone see and speak with Grimny's ghost. Dr. Uriah could not tell whether it is cursed, and Grimny has since departed.
facts.uncertain_reason: Grimny's ghost ascended (beat_81), so it is unclear whether the ring still does anything; whether it is cursed is unknown.
